text:
If your Wednesday plans are waiting on the promised sunshine, the sky is running late. Burlington is still cloudy and 59, with a damp feel, but the clouds should break some this afternoon as we climb toward 68. It’s a dry afternoon, and the south wind stays light around town, though the lake is a little livelier with 10 to 15-knot winds and waves near a foot.

Tonight stays mostly cloudy with a low around 57, so don’t expect much clearing for the evening. Thursday is the warmer day, reaching about 74 with a stronger south breeze, gusting as high as 26, and the lake building to 1- to 2-foot waves. The next meaningful shower chance waits until after midnight Thursday night. Take the afternoon walk today, but bring a light layer for the waterfront and keep longer lake outings to the calmer side.

week.blurb: Partly sunny and mild near 68, a decent afternoon for errands, patios, or an easy walk.
More sun than clouds and a mild 74 make Thursday a good day for outdoor plans before showers arrive overnight.
Rain showers likely with a high near 70, so keep Friday flexible and expect a decidedly damp day.
Sunny but cooler near 62, with a crisp, clear night, so plan on layers after dark.
Mostly sunny and near 65, with a good daytime window before showers become possible Sunday night.
Cooler near 58 with a few showers possible, so keep Monday plans flexible and bring a light layer.
Mostly sunny but chilly near 53, with a brisk northwest wind making layers essential for Tuesday plans.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Wednesday! Our Wednesday starts with some area of low clouds and fog, most of which should begin to diminish into the rest of this morning. Otherwise, through the rest of the day, we’ll call it a mix of sun and clouds. While it’s not a perfectly sunny day, I do suspect there will be more breaks of sunshine than what we have seen the last several days. High temperatures for the day head back into the mid-to-upper 60s to about 70 come this afternoon. Tonight, overnight lows dip into the 50s.
